name: Chocolate Pistachio Zucchini Bread

ingredients.name: grated zucchini, from about 2 medium zucchini

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 175°C (350°F). Spray a 9-by-13-cm metal loaf pan with cooking spray; set aside.

In a large bowl with a hand mixer, or in the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with a paddle attachment, beat sugar, butter, oil, and vanilla on medium speed until smooth and fluffy, about 2 minutes. Beat in egg until just incorporated, about 30 seconds.

In a medium bowl, whisk together flour, cocoa powder, salt, baking soda, and baking powder until very well combined, about 30 seconds. Add flour mixture to butter mixture in 3 additions, alternating with sour cream and beating on medium speed until just combined after each addition (batter will be thick). Stir in zucchini, chocolate morsels or chips, and 1/3 cup of pistachios, if using, until well combined. Scrape batter into prepared pan, smoothing top with a rubber spatula. Sprinkle with remaining pistachios, if using.

Bake until loaf is domed and set and a cake tester or wooden pick inserted in the center comes out with a few moist crumbs attached, or to an internal temperature of around 93°C in the center of the loaf, about 1 hour. Loosely tent with aluminum foil during the last 10 minutes of baking to prevent nuts from overbrowning, if needed. Transfer pan to a wire rack and cool in pan for 15 to 30 minutes. Run a butter knife along edges to loosen. Remove from pan and let cool completely on wire rack, about 1 hour. Slice with a serrated knife and serve.

description: This easy chocolate zucchini bread is moist, tender, and packed with bittersweet chocolate and crunchy pistachios. No squeezing the zucchini required.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 2 hr 35 min.

Optional or for serving: 70 g unsalted pistachios (71 g; 1/2 cup), finely chopped, divided (optional)

Optional substitutions: bittersweet chocolate morsels → chips

Notes: To grate zucchini, you can use the large holes of a box grater or shred it in your food processor using the grating disc.
To make muffins, divide batter evenly among 12 lightly greased nonstick muffin cups, adding about 60 g to each cup. Bake until tops are domed and golden brown, about 25 minutes.

Make-ahead and storage: The cooled loaf can be covered tightly with plastic wrap or stored in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 4 days or frozen for up to 2 months.
author: Laila Ibrahim
